name: Davnar II
description: Davnar II, or simply Davnar, was a little-known planet in the Davnar system of the Kanchen sector, located in the Core Worlds.
lead_paragraphs: Davnar II, or simply Davnar, was a little-known planet in the Davnar system of the Kanchen sector, located in the Core Worlds.
It was the Kalidor and another native species' homeworld. The Kalidor Crescent was a Rebel Alliance medal of honor, named in honor the creature of this planet.
